milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate to and visually observe the potted blue orchid placed inside the open gazebo at spawn-relative (8, 3, 8). max_distance=5 ensures the player must actually walk to the gazebo (orchid is ~11.7 blocks from spawn, so they can't satisfy this from spawn). facing_tolerance=60 confirms the player is looking toward the orchid, verifying visual identification rather than just proximity.

scene_description: A flat grass area with an open gazebo structure containing a potted blue orchid on a shelf. Decoy flower pots (potted dandelion, potted poppy, empty flower pot) are scattered around the area to require the player to identify the correct target. The gazebo is open on all sides with only fence post corners, making the orchid visible but requiring navigation to confirm it.
task_text: Find the potted blue orchid in the area. Look around the structures and identify the blue orchid among other flower pots.
design_notes: The gazebo is at relative (+6 to +10, +1 to +4, +4 to +8) from spawn. The potted blue orchid sits on an oak slab shelf at (~8, ~3, ~8). The open structure with only fence corner posts ensures visibility from outside. Decoys are placed at various distances: potted_dandelion at (-3,1,0), empty flower_pot at (0,1,-5), potted_poppy at (-6,1,5). The /fill air command clears all natural trees within 12 blocks of spawn to ensure clean sightlines. Distance from spawn to orchid is ~11.7 blocks.
